headline: Bournemouth 15th but favourites: the chances say more than the table
summary: Bournemouth are 15th in the Premier League with 6 points, yet the market makes them narrow home favourites against Leeds on Saturday. The reason is in the chances: Bournemouth create 2.36 expected goals a game and concede 0.81, numbers far better than their results. Leeds are 7th with 10 points and have lost only 1 league game; Yahoo Sports report Joe Rodon could return from a thigh injury. With the bookmakers' margin removed, Bournemouth are 42.7% to win, and the handicap gives Leeds a 0.25-goal head start. Over 2.75 goals is a 47.3% chance.
read: Leeds, seventh with 10 points and one defeat in seven, are rated only a quarter of a goal behind, and the 2.75 goals line plus two straight 2-2 meetings point to a tight, low-margin game.

facts.fact: Bournemouth are the market's favourites at 42.7% to win at home to Leeds.
Bournemouth created 4.4 expected goals in their 2-0 home win over Sunderland on 18 October, conceding just 0.13.
facts.meaning: It was their first league win of the season and by some distance their most dominant performance — the level the market is really pricing here.

facts.fact: Bournemouth lost 5-1 at Chelsea in their last league away game, but the xG read 1.38 to 1.10 in their favour.
Leeds are seventh with 10 points from seven games, having lost just once.
facts.meaning: The visitors arrive with the better league record, eight places above Bournemouth.

facts.fact: The handicap fair line makes Bournemouth about a quarter of a goal the better side.
The total-goals line is set at 2.75, with the over priced at 47.3%.
facts.meaning: Two or three goals is the central expectation — the market is not convinced this turns into a shootout.

facts.fact: The last two meetings both finished 2-2 — at Bournemouth in April and at Elland Road in September 2025.
facts.meaning: Recent history says these two cancel each other out and both find the net.

facts.fact: Leeds' best result of the run is a 4-1 home win over Newcastle, with the xG 2.08 to 0.88.
facts.meaning: It is the one game where their finishing matched their chance creation — the template for how they can hurt Bournemouth.

sources.fact: Bournemouth beat Sunderland 2-0 at the Vitality Stadium to secure their first league win of the season and move out of the relegation zone.
Bournemouth were beaten 5-1 by Chelsea in the Premier League at Stamford Bridge, per Chelsea's official highlights.
Marco Rose's injury update indicates Bournemouth's Junior Kroupi is the subject of the latest fitness news ahead of the AC Milan clash.
Goalkeeper Petrovic remains Marco Rose's starter for Bournemouth, with Di Gregorio limited to one Carabao Cup appearance since arriving on loan.
Bournemouth boss Marco Rose said every game and every opponent is interesting and that the focus is on the AC Milan match.
Leeds drew 1-1 with Manchester United at Elland Road, Dominic Calvert-Lewin cancelling out Bryan Mbeumo's opener.
Leeds reached an agreement with Daniel Farke on a new deal, seen as a step towards their progress after a strong start to the season, per Football Insider.
Leeds centre-back Joe Rodon is making good progress after his thigh injury, with a possible return in time for the Bournemouth game, according to early team news.
